items.question: On which day should one worship the beloved youthful woman with effort?
premises: Friday is the day for worship.
The worship is performed with effort.
The object is a youthful beloved woman.
items.inference: The verse prescribes Friday worship of a youthful beloved woman performed with effort.
uncertainties: Exact ritual context of mithunārcana is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: On Friday, one should worship with effort a beloved woman who has attained youth.
